items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: he was out there in Chicago with Joe Oliver, the old man, Joe Oliver.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, it got around, began getting around, Fletcher's name began to go up and everybody came to hear Fletcher, Fletcher, Fletcher, Fletcher. Then he wanted to expand his band. He wanted to get two more men. And he told us he was trying to get another trumpet player. That was Louis Armstrong, from -- he was out there in Chicago with Joe Oliver, the old man, Joe Oliver.

Well, we finally got Louis and he came to the band. He had high shoes on, button shoes. And a cardboard suitcase, and his stomach was way out like this.
